correctness.rationale: For every blade vertex outside an alliance, neighborhood counts yield 2*s_i>=m_i-1 when center selected and 2*s_i>=m_i+1 when center omitted. These are exactly s_i>=floor(m_i/2) and s_i>=floor(m_i/2)+1. When center omitted the latter sum automatically satisfies the outside center inequality because 2*sum_i s_i>=sum_i m_i+2*r-o >=sum_i m_i+1 (o number odd blades and r>=2). Therefore local thresholds are necessary and sufficient for all sets, whence x*product of upper binomial tails A_m plus product of strict tails B_m; minimum size 1+sum floor(m_i/2), all minimizers include center, count product binomial. Independent direct neighborhood enumeration compared every subset on 2031 checked graph/subset instances; the unbounded theorem follows the local inequalities.
